scope: Default viewer-friendly GIF recording in ai-dev-browser; sudohand migration remains parked.

audit.naming: Existing page_record_start/page_record_stop core functions and generated tool filenames remain identical.
audit.parameters: demo=True is defined once in core; --no-demo is derived by wrap_core. out, fps, max_duration and recording_id are preserved.
audit.discovery: Core opening paragraph selects recording for a GIF and screenshot for a still image. It exposes default cursor/click/timing, --out, and --recording-id. tools/__init__.py and screenshot help lead to recording.
audit.returns: CLI and SDK share the core result. Start returns recording_id and demo after the first frame; stop returns saved path, byte size, dimensions and duration. Successful stop is the completion signal.
audit.failures: Validation=exit 2; existing output conflict=exit 5 and retryable=false; interrupted capture is never published. Real model recovery preserved the conflicting file.
audit.composition: 61 generated tools, zero new commands. Existing human mouse path, trusted CDP input, verified typing, viewport command and recording JSON persistence are reused. The shared input recorder observes events; positioning remains in the existing gesture functions so explicit move=False and the best-effort click contract are honored.
audit.model_findings: The final paid run selected the correct recording tools from names/first lines, requested actual help where needed, and completed both workflows. Default recording used four successful tool calls with no invalid arguments. Recovery repaired one existing click parameter guess; the audit does not claim zero parameter guesses across all scenarios.
audit.multi_tab_targeting: Use the existing --tab-url parameter to select another tab explicitly; recording remains pinned to its original target.

regression_protection.artifacts: CI retains actual GIFs, sampled decoded frames and evidence JSON for 7 days.
regression_protection.paid_models: Opt-in scripts/live_recording_steering.py, run locally with real API credentials before commit.
regression_protection.release_assets: Release validation requires core/_demo.py inside the wheel, along with the existing recorder and generated recording tools.

live_checks.real_cli: Trusted movement restored across fresh CLI processes; single trusted click; paced prefix input events; held-button drag; resize; navigation; final cursor pixels; screenshot excludes the output overlay.
live_checks.opt_out: --no-demo returns demo=false, uses ordinary insertText, and saves page-only pixels.
live_checks.extension: Real bundled extension through both legacy and asyncio WebSocket servers; separate SDK connections; trusted movement/click/typing; decoded GIF feedback.
live_checks.scope: Other tab uses ordinary insertText during recording; recorded tab uses human typing; ordinary typing resumes after stop.
live_checks.gif_playback: Opened the actual saved GIF in an adb-driven Chrome tab; inspected 8 browser screenshots over a complete loop and decoded click/ending frames. Local deliverable: output/recording-demo/demo.gif.
live_checks.encoding: A 60-frame moving pointer fixture is under 20 KB and erases previous pointer positions. The improved Gaussian path settles at its target across 20 seeds.
bugs_fixed_from_live_runs: Mean-shifted Gaussian noise caused overshoot and a final jump; use zero-mean tapered noise.
Chrome removes transient CLI viewport overrides; the recorder holds the requested viewport and follows window_set.
Post-screenshot layout metrics could report another viewport; resolve final-frame coordinates before capture.
live_checks.final_local_gate: 12 passed: recording format/unit and real browser demo workflows, including both real extension WebSocket backends.
live_checks.unit_suite: 127 passed in the repaired project Python 3.13 environment.
live_checks.public_website: Real Wikipedia home -> paced keystroke query -> trusted search click -> Google Chrome article -> saved GIF. 1 passed, 51 GIF frames, 13.77 seconds, 1,135,235 bytes. Evidence: scratch/demo-wikipedia-live/test_recording_public_web_live0/public-evidence.json; local deliverable: output/recording-demo/wikipedia.gif.
live_checks.click_compatibility: 11 real-browser checks passed, including both extension backends, --no-move without an interpolated move, and a single trusted click after an injected optional positioning timeout. Targeted multi-tab rerun passed with explicit --tab-url on every target-sensitive call.
live_checks.model_harness: The final text-only runner uses names and first-line summaries, then supplies actual CLI --help on request. It records raw model text, accepts exactly one unambiguous JSON choice with optional prose, and fails missing/ambiguous choices. Both paid workflows passed on the final click implementation. A native structured-output experiment was rejected by the provider (schema restrictions and safeguards) and is not used by the committed runner.
